questions.question: You duplicate every example and keep the same learning rate. What happens to a sum-loss SGD update compared with the original batch?
options: Its gradient and update magnitude double.
It stays unchanged because the data values are unchanged.
value_and_grad silently converts the sum to a mean.
questions.explanation: A sum counts each replicated contribution again. A mean divides by the new batch size and would preserve the gradient in this example.
